name: ru-sentence-v1
description: Russian sentence generation from a meaning triple — the mirror of the English generator. Subject stays nominative, the verb is conjugated to 3rd person singular (lang.rule.present3sg.ru), the object is declined to the accusative (lang.rule.acc-sg.ru), and the S-V-O order is induced from examples and field-stored. No articles. Generation from given roles, not parsing; regular conjugation only (writing/motion verbs that mutate the stem, and soft stems, are out of scope).
